read.thesis: Record-pace earnings with no supply-side signal; buybacks cut to $664M to redeploy capital into organic growth, Q4 NII ex-markets guided to $25.5B and 2027 central case $107B, while management flags slower IB activity.

triggers.label: Buybacks cut to $664M
triggers.quote: We believe now, which is different than we told you in the past, that we can redeploy that capital at very good returns over time.

triggers.label: IB activity slowed in late September
triggers.quote: evolving market conditions have recently slowed activity a bit, so we will have to see how the quarter develops.

triggers.label: Credit terms loosening, JPM tightening
triggers.quote: I think some of the credit terms have got a little bit loose.

guidance.quote: We expect fourth quarter NII ex-markets to be approximately $25.5 billion and fourth quarter total NII to be about $28 billion.
we gave you a central case for 2027 NII ex-markets of approximately $107 billion, which we will refine further next quarter.
we expect the fourth quarter to be about $27.5 billion
we continue to expect the card net charge off rate to be approximately 3.2%.

red_flags.label: Loosening leveraged credit terms
red_flags.quote: I think some of the credit terms have got a little bit loose.

red_flags.label: AI-theme concentration in wholesale exposure
red_flags.quote: that is not the same as saying that we would be immune to a major change in sentiment in the AI space.

evasions.quote: a lot of moving parts. But for now, the consensus does not seem too far off.
I am just very reluctant to spend a lot of energy quantifying it
we do not actually guide to that.
